structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Medical records; ownership; provision of copies
law.text: Medical records maintained by any health care provider as defined in § 32.1-127.1:03 shall be the property of such health care provider or, in the case of a health care provider employed by another health care provider, the property of the employer. Such health care provider shall release copies of any such medical records in compliance with § 32.1-127.1:03 or § 8.01-413, if the request is made for purposes of litigation, or as otherwise provided by state or federal law.
